one_line_contribution: It measures whether LLM consolidation of a shared multi-contributor experience memory amplifies a low-trust minority's poison beyond its raw-record share (laundering vs dilution) on ALFWorld/WebShop, and prices lineage-based trust enforcement as a fan-in law 1-(1-s)^f, with trust-partitioned consolidation offered as the cheaper enforcement point.
closest_prior_work: MemLineage: Lineage-Guided Enforcement for LLM Agent Memory (arXiv:2605.14421, 2026-05-14, VERIFIED via the literature command; 12 citations) attaches cryptographic provenance AND LLM-mediated derivation lineage to every memory entry and evaluates three defense cells against three memory-poisoning workloads. That is precisely this proposal's min-trust lineage arm, already published, so the mechanism is not new; the proposal's differentiator is that MemLineage's harness is a deterministic mechanism-isolation setup rather than an agent benchmark, and that it reports no utility cost curve. MAP-Graph (arXiv:2608.10509, 2026-08-11, VERIFIED via search; 4 citations) independently establishes provenance propagated through derivations as an operational control signal. On the attack side the qualitative laundering direction is also largely spoken for: Manufactured Confidence (arXiv:2606.29279, 2026-06-28, VERIFIED) shows consolidation rewrites a hedged remark into a confident dated assertion the agent then obeys, and SkillJack (arXiv:2608.03509, VERIFIED) shows poisoned histories become persistent skills that survive source deletion. Two neighbours the proposal does not cite tighten this further: PoisonedEvolution (arXiv:2608.05563, 2026-08-06, VERIFIED) names evidence promotion in self-evolving skill systems as a security boundary, and Grading the Narrators / Isnad-Rijal (arXiv:2607.24117, VERIFIED) already combines weakest-link (i.e. min-trust) chain evaluation, independent corroboration, and decoupled content criticism for routing and quarantine of derived claims — the proposal's arm set minus the cost curve. What survives as genuinely unclaimed is the quantitative laundering-vs-dilution rate with real consolidators on agent tasks and the enforcement-cost frontier; that is a measurement delta on an occupied mechanism, not a new claim.
strongest_objection: The central cost premise is an artifact of a design choice, and the head-to-head is rigged so its falsifier cannot fire. (a) Prediction 3 asks whether the blocked fraction matches 1-(1-s)^f within 5 points. If clusters of size f are drawn from a pool that is s low-trust, that identity is the binomial complement — it tests the sampling procedure, not the memory system. Confirming it is not a finding, and the only informative outcome (semantic clustering concentrates a contributor's episodes, so contamination is lumpier than independent draws) is framed as the failure case. (b) Min-trust exclusion is presented as the only lineage-faithful option, but the obvious remedy is not exclusion at all: re-consolidate the derived record from its honest parent subset. Trust-partitioned consolidation is essentially that remedy applied ex ante, and since the low-trust contributor here is a pure adversary with no unique useful coverage, all cross-honest merges survive partitioning and only merges with an adversary's records are lost — merges of negative value. Prediction 4 (partitioned retains >=90% of clean utility) is therefore near-guaranteed by construction, and the escape clause 'unless cross-trust merges carry most of the value of sharing' is never stressed by any arm except the single mislabeled-honest cell. The paper would then report a dominance result that the setup manufactured. (c) The laundering measurement itself degrades exactly where the paper needs it most: planted lexical markers are the upper bound, but the round-2 adaptive attacker's whole job is to rephrase poison into general rules, which destroys the markers; the laundering fraction under the adaptive attacker is then measured almost entirely by the entailment judge, whose recall on paraphrased general rules is unvalidated. Prediction 5's noise-band claim rests on that instrument.
what_would_fix_it: Three changes. (1) Give the low-trust contributor real value: make it the sole source of correct coverage for some task families (a partially poisoned insider, poison rate well below 100%), so exclusion and partitioning both incur a genuine opportunity cost and prediction 4 can actually fail; the mislabeled-honest cell should then be a sweep over the poison rate within the distrusted contributor, not a single arm. (2) Drop the fan-in law as a confirmatory prediction and make the deviation the result: pre-register the independent-draw baseline 1-(1-s)^f, then report how much semantic clustering concentrates contamination above or below it, with the concentration coefficient as the reported quantity. (3) Replace binary min-trust with a family: graded ancestor-trust down-weighting, corroboration-based admission (keep a derived claim if two independent honest parents support it), and re-consolidation from the honest parent subset — the last is the arm that determines whether a 'blast radius' exists at all. Separately, validate the entailment judge's recall on adversarially rephrased poison against a hand-labelled set before it carries prediction 5, and cut the grid (see feasibility) so the surviving cells are actually powered.
missing_baseline: Two, both load-bearing. First, re-consolidation from the honest parent subset: instead of discarding a derived record with a low-trust ancestor, recompute it from its clean parents. This is cheap, lineage-faithful, and would make most of the claimed fan-in cost evaporate, so its absence is what a reviewer will attack. Second, graded rather than binary trust propagation — continuous ancestor-trust down-weighting at retrieval (the additive provenance penalties that Utility Under Attack, arXiv:2608.21230, VERIFIED, explicitly evaluates and argues against; provenance-DAG credit propagation as in MemQ, arXiv:2605.08374; weakest-link-plus-corroboration grading as in arXiv:2607.24117) and corroboration-based admission of derived claims. A consolidation-time faithfulness verifier such as TRUSTMEM (arXiv:2606.25161, VERIFIED) is a third omission: it defends at the exact pipeline stage the paper claims is unguarded.
preprint_collision: No verified collision on the full central claim. The proposal's own check is unusually good for this stage — it names channels, date windows, query strings and IDs, and admits that two abstracts could not be fetched — and I credit it; it is not thin or unsearched. All nine IDs the novelty argument leans on VERIFIED via the literature command (Semantic Scholar + HuggingFace, channel (a); WebSearch unavailable in this session and never used): 2605.14421 MemLineage, 2608.10509 MAP-Graph, 2606.29279 Manufactured Confidence, 2608.03509 SkillJack, 2605.18930 OEP, 2608.21230 Utility Under Attack, 2606.24535 Governed Shared Memory, 2605.12978 Useful Memories Become Faulty, 2505.18279 Collaborative Memory. Note that 2608.10509, 2605.14421, 2606.29279 and 2605.18930 return nothing from `s2cli.py paper <id>` but do resolve through title/keyword search, so the proposal's ID set is sound. My queries, all answered by channel (a): (i) 'memory consolidation launders poisoned agent experience provenance lineage shared memory' --recent — returned SkillJack 2608.03509, MemoryGraft 2512.16962, Zombie Agents 2602.15654, FARMA/SENTINEL 2607.05029, MemIR 2605.25869, A-MemGuard 2510.02373, SuperLocalMemory 2603.02240, AgentSys 2602.07398, Collaborative Memory 2505.18279; no laundering-rate measurement. (ii) 'provenance lineage derived records trust propagation multi-agent shared memory access control' (no date limit) — returned MAP-Graph 2608.10509, MemLineage 2605.14421, and three papers the proposal missed: GateMem 2606.18829 (a benchmark that already jointly scores utility against access control and forgetting in multi-principal shared memory — the closest thing to the proposal's risk-utility frontier, though at the raw-record admission level), Grading the Narrators 2607.24117 (weakest-link claim-chain grading with corroboration and quarantine), and From Spark to Fire 2603.04474 (genealogy-graph governance of error cascades). (iii) 'summarization amplifies minority poisoned content survival rate' --recent — nothing on-mechanism (RAG poisoning only). (iv) 'blast radius fan-in cost of excluding derived records provenance quarantine utility tradeoff' --recent — returned two unrelated papers; effectively EMPTY, which I report as empty, not as evidence of novelty. (v) 'poison survives consolidation into insights skills rate ALFWorld WebShop' — SkillJack, SkillHarm 2606.02540, 2605.12978; no rate measurement. (vi) 'over-experience poisoning ... self-evolving' — surfaced PoisonedEvolution 2608.05563 (2026-08-06), which the proposal's check missed and which is the nearest new threat: it names evidence promotion in self-evolving skill systems as the security boundary, i.e. the laundering step, though it does not report a survival rate against contributor share or any enforcement cost. (vii) 'epistemic laundering ... consolidation' --recent and (viii) a title query for Manufactured Confidence — the latter verified 2606.29279 and also surfaced TRUSTMEM 2606.25161, a consolidation-time trust verifier the proposal neither cites nor baselines. Net: the individual pieces (laundering direction, lineage enforcement, governance utility cost) each have a 2026 preprint; nobody has yet published the joint rate-plus-cost measurement, so novelty is diminished by crowding rather than voided by collision.
